market_pulse.note: Around $60,280, up about 1.4% in a Saturday snapshot, after falling to about $55,300 overnight, its lowest since September 2024; CoinCodex had it at $55,796, down 9.9% over 24 hours, at 1 AM ET (Eurasia Business News; Bitcoin.com News; CoinCodex).
Around $1,691, up about 2.2% in a Saturday snapshot, after trading near $1,559, down 10.4% over 24 hours, at 1 AM ET (Eurasia Business News; CoinCodex).
About $2.00 trillion at 1 AM ET, down 5.4% from $2.11 trillion over 24 hours, per CoinCodex; trading volume rose about 34% to $112 billion (CoinCodex).
About 56.2% at 1 AM ET on CoinCodex's measure; CoinGabbar, using CoinGecko data a few hours earlier, put it near 58% (CoinCodex; CoinGabbar).

themes.title: Bounce back to $60,000
themes.summary: Bitcoin climbed back above $60,000 Saturday morning after dropping to about $55,300 overnight; it remains about 52% below its October 2025 record of $126,080 (Bitcoin.com News; Eurasia Business News).

themes.title: Billions in liquidations
themes.summary: About $2.4 billion to $2.67 billion of leveraged positions were wiped out over 24 hours, mostly longs, including more than $1 billion in Bitcoin futures, per CoinGlass data (Bitcoin.com News; Eurasia Business News).

themes.title: ETF outflows
themes.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs had more than $1.25 billion of net outflows from Tuesday to Friday, including $582 million on Thursday, of which BlackRock's IBIT accounted for $541 million (Bitcoin.com News).

themes.title: Tech selloff and Fed worries
themes.summary: The Nasdaq fell 5.3% Friday and about 10% for the week, and hot October inflation data raised fears of a December Fed rate increase (Bitcoin.com News; CoinGabbar).

themes.title: Extreme fear
themes.summary: The Crypto Fear and Greed Index read 12, in extreme fear, compared with 68 a month ago, per Alternative.me (CoinGabbar).

categories.name: Majors (BTC/ETH)
categories.note: Both rebounded Saturday, with Bitcoin up about 1.4% and Ether about 2.2% in a midday snapshot, after roughly 10% drops overnight (Eurasia Business News; CoinCodex).

categories.name: Large-cap altcoins
categories.note: Solana led the rebound, up about 3.7% to $70.86, and XRP rose about 2.2% to $0.93; Hyperliquid (HYPE) slipped 0.4% to $61.28 (Eurasia Business News).

categories.name: Crypto stocks
categories.note: Strategy fell about 30% for the week, Coinbase and Robinhood about 20% each, and Ether treasury firm Bitmine about 26% (Bitcoin.com News).

categories.name: Stablecoins and DeFi
categories.note: Stablecoin market cap held near $280 billion, down 0.4%, while DeFi market cap fell 5.6% to about $53 billion, per CoinGecko data (CoinGabbar).

watch_list.why: Bitcoin is trying to hold $60,000 after lows near $55,300; it was above $62,000 Thursday and $65,000 early in the week, and Wintermute warns it could fall into the $50,000s unless ETF inflows return (Bitcoin.com News).
MSCI is set to remove Strategy (MSTR), a large Bitcoin holder, from some U.S. indexes after the close on Nov. 30 (CoinStats).
Spot ETFs do not trade on weekends; October PCE inflation data is due Nov. 25, ahead of the Dec. 9 Fed decision (Admirals; Bitcoin.com News).
